Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as AI rally lifts Nasdaq ahead of Fed decision
Markets.summary: US stocks closed higher as an artificial intelligence rally led by chipmakers boosted the Nasdaq ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision. Investors also evaluated corporate earnings reports while anticipating that interest rates would remain unchanged.

Markets.title: NYSE bets on all-or-nothing options as event driven trading gains traction
Markets.summary: The New York Stock Exchange is launching binary return options that allow investors to make all-or-nothing wagers on stock and ETF closing prices. The exchange is also seeking approval for new KPI options tied to company earnings to expand its event-driven trading products.

Markets.title: Boeing cuts delivery target, shares hit 18-month low as recovery takes longer
Markets.summary: Boeing reduced its 737 Max delivery target and reported a wider-than-expected loss in its commercial airplane division. These setbacks caused the company's shares to hit an 18-month low as its recovery takes longer than anticipated.

Markets.title: Prediction market Kalshi expands safeguards for young traders
Markets.summary: Prediction market Kalshi has introduced a $2,500 monthly deposit limit and new trade alerts for users aged 18 to 20. The company implemented these safeguards and youth safety partnerships amid rising scrutiny over gambling risks.

Markets.title: GM to transfer stock listing to Nasdaq
Markets.summary: General Motors announced on Tuesday that it is moving its common stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq. The company made the switch as part of a strategy to improve its market position.

Markets.title: Trading starts on LME's first contract from Shanghai exchange collaboration
Markets.summary: The London Metal Exchange launched its first joint product with the Shanghai Futures Exchange on Tuesday with trading of a new hot-rolled coil steel contract. Over 550 lots traded in the first two active months, though two 2027 contracts were delayed due to a potential technical issue.

Geo-Political.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
Geo-Political.summary: The leaders of Norway and Finland recently held a rare phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the war. Following the conversation, Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that ending the conflict in Ukraine requires active communication rather than silence.

Geo-Political.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Officials report that a ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region has been extended. Both Russia and Ukraine state that no breaches of the truce have occurred since it was originally established for residents in Oleshky.

Geo-Political.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
Geo-Political.summary: French football star Kylian Mbappé apologized after referring to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong as a "dictator" during an interview. The remark triggered a significant backlash in China, prompting the player to call his comment ill-judged.

Geo-Political.title: Lula's comeback in Brazil dents Trump's ambitions for Latin America
Geo-Political.summary: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s return to the Brazilian presidency undermines Donald Trump's political influence and strategic goals in Latin America. Although their diplomatic relations have recently improved, persistent policy disagreements could easily revive conflicts between the two administrations.

Geo-Political.title: Dutch zookeeper dies after being mauled by leopard
Geo-Political.summary: A veteran Dutch zookeeper has died after being mauled by a leopard at the park where she worked. She had been employed at the facility on-and-off for four decades, beginning her career there at the age of 17.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president freed after collapse of attempted murder case
Geo-Political.summary: Marry Mubaiwa, the ex-wife of Zimbabwe's vice-president, was freed after the attempted murder case against her collapsed. She had spent seven years on remand following her initial arrest and charges in 2019.

Data & Insights.title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags need for 'prudent borrowing' as states face fiscal management challenges
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged states to adopt prudent borrowing, improve spending quality, and strengthen cash management for fiscal sustainability. He also recommended expanding the use of digital platforms for lending and direct benefit transfers.

Data & Insights.title: Why India should resist the temptation to defend the rupee at any cost, Raghuram Rajan explains
Data & Insights.summary: Former Reserve Bank of India Governor Raghuram Rajan advises against spending excessive resources to prop up the rupee. Instead, policymakers should accept the currency's decline when driven by broader economic conditions.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial credit growth nears 20%, signals private capex revival; Shaktikanta Das urges banks to fund strategic sectors
Data & Insights.summary: Industrial credit growth reached nearly 20% in July, signaling an early revival in private capital expenditure. RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das urged banks to finance strategic sectors like infrastructure, semiconductors, and defence manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate to 6.25% by H1 2027, warns Deutsche Bank as inflation risks persist
Data & Insights.summary: Deutsche Bank predicts the RBI will raise the repo rate to 6.25% by the first half of 2027 due to ongoing inflation. The bank also warns that the Indian rupee could depreciate past 97 per US dollar.

Data & Insights.title: 'Don't panic over rupee fall': Raghuram Rajan warns against exhausting forex reserves
Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan has warned India against depleting its foreign exchange reserves to defend the falling rupee. India has already spent roughly half of the $140 billion secured earlier this year for currency support and banking liquidity.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab LIVE Updates: Cyclone Arnab Makes Landfall, Eastern States See Heavy Rainfall
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab is expected to make landfall between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam along the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts. The storm will cross the region between 2 am and 4 am, bringing heavy rainfall to eastern states.

India.title: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Wins First Seat In Bihar Upper House
India.summary: Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj party won one seat in the Bihar Legislative Council elections. The ruling NDA is set to win five of the eight total seats, while Independents secured the remaining two.

India.title: Indian Firm L&T Wins Major Dhaka Metro Contract
India.summary: Indian firm Larsen & Toubro has won a major contract for Dhaka's metro rail system. The Bangladesh government is implementing three metro rail projects in the capital at a total cost of Tk 2.5 trillion.

India.title: Delhi Government May Hike Agricultural Land Circle Rates After 18 Years
India.summary: The Delhi government is considering increasing agricultural land circle rates up to Rs 5 crore per acre in certain districts. These property valuations have remained unchanged since 2008.

India.title: Cyclone Arnab: Flights Suspended At 3 Andhra Airports, Airlines Cancel Services
India.summary: Cyclone Arnab has caused the suspension of flights at three airports in Andhra Pradesh. Airlines have cancelled services and are required to keep passengers informed about delays, rebooking, and refunds.

India.title: Delhi Assembly Met For Just 17 Days In 2025. Speaker Backs 30-Sitting Target
India.summary: The Delhi Assembly met for only 17 days in 2025. During a meeting on Tuesday, the Assembly Speaker supported a proposal to set a target of 30 sittings per year.

General.title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises
General.summary: John Healey's upcoming first Budget will focus heavily on cost-of-living support, particularly energy bills, and announcements on devolution. The financial plan must take meaningful steps toward fulfilling the Prime Minister's promises.

General.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
General.summary: Chancellor John Healey will announce new minimum wage rates and cost-of-living relief measures in the upcoming Budget. However, the wage increase will not apply to 18-to-20-year-olds.

General.title: Two in court over alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford
General.summary: Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir, both 24, appeared at Westminster Magistrates' Court on Tuesday. The two men face charges over an alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford.

General.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
General.summary: The King has begun a nine-day Caribbean tour visiting the Bahamas, Guyana, and Antigua and Barbuda. During the trip, he acknowledged the suffering of the past.

General.title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told
General.summary: Four men are on trial for abusing a woman after her ex-husband drugged and advertised her online. The ex-husband has already pleaded guilty to drugging and raping her.

General.title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned
General.summary: MPs have warned that the planned switch to digital landlines by January could leave remote areas of the UK vulnerable during emergencies. They caution that the transition risks cutting people off when they need to call for help.
